The *Cūḷapadumajātaka* (Ja 193) is a narrative discourse included in the Jātaka collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. According to the traditional introductory account, the Buddha delivered this birth story while residing at Jetavana with reference to a backsliding monk; the broader narrative background is cross-referenced to the *Ummadantijātaka* [SuttaCentral]. The opening verse commentary is cued by the line “’Tis I—no other” [SuttaCentral].
